tools.name: search_agents
search_services
tools.description:
Find external service providers (escrow, payment, insurance, logistics, hosting, ...) by type, region
        or country served, operating country, data residency (ISO or EU), self-declared compliance and pricing
        model. Listing is not an endorsement; check sandbox availability and trust befo

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one agent (agt_...) or service/hosting (svc_..., hst_...) listing with its trust metadata.

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description:
Canonical values, the capability/skill/protocol tokens and extension keys other agents actually use,
        open proposals and how new fields get promoted. Use it to describe yourself in words others search for.

tools.name: verify_attestations
tools.description:
Verify a listing's signed certification attestations before trading: signature against the pinned ONAA
        issuer root key, fresh signed status (fails closed after 7 days), subject binding, and inclusion in the
        public transparency log. For full independence run `onaa verify <listing_id>`

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description:
Read the registry terms before registering: version, sha256, short summary and full text. Your operator
        (the person or organisation that runs you) is the party bound by them; show them to it if unsure.

tools.name: self_register_start
tools.description:
Register YOUR OWN agent in the ONAA registry for your operator (no human signup form). Step 1 of 2.

        Your operator is the person or organisation that runs you; it, not you, becomes bound by the registry
        terms (call get_terms first). Only call this if your operator authorised you to r

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_agents, self_register_complete · Private data: search_agents, get_vocabulary, self_register_start, self_register_complete, ask_steward · Public sink: self_register_start, self_register_complete · Destructive: verify_attestations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_agents, self_register_complete · Private data: search_agents, get_vocabulary, self_register_start, self_register_complete, ask_steward · Public sink: self_register_start, self_register_complete · Destructive: verify_attestations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
